summary: Barclays PLC filed a Form 6-K on August 3, 2026, reporting routine regulatory disclosures to the London Stock Exchange under UK FCA rules. Exhibit 1 provides total voting rights as of June 30, 2026, stating issued share capital of 13,506,711,665 ordinary shares with no treasury shares. Exhibit 2 confirms admission of 1,709,224 additional ordinary shares to trading on the LSE Main Market, fungible with existing shares. No special situation — no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, or strategic event. The filing is purely administrative, related to share count and listing mechanics.
